race.comment: It's a bit of D-Day for the $5.6 million filly CHAYAN (1) but she's going better than the formguide reads. Never in the hunt first up in the G2 Furious Stakes then ran the fastest last 400m of the day at Caulfield in a race dominated on speed. She's since won a jumpout down the straight and won't be as far off them here in what looks a much more winnable race. AROUSED (11) is very interesting off a dominant maiden win at Ballarat on debut, coming away to score by three lengths in fast time. Straight to 1200m down the straight but she looks plenty talented. ANGELS FURY (3) resumes. She was the boom filly of the Winter but didn't really get to some of the good races she was touted for. Fresh at 1200m is a bit of a niggle but respecting.
